accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:all-band-converse
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The all-honest-band lower bound is conditional on construction of the fixed-nuisance marked Bernoulli modulus in oeq:fixed-nuisance-marked-modulus.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The expected-width rate is sharp conditional on an affirmative fixed-nuisance marked-modulus construction; the open construction remains the principal Stage-0 target.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Article abstract; Theorem 1 is described in the article's identification section.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies two repeated measurements with independently distributed error coordinates, establishes blind identifiability, and gives compact-support density estimation/minimax results; it is an unmarked signal-density paper.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2, especially equations (1)--(3) and Assumption 1; introduction paragraphs on inference.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes a known measurement-error characteristic function, identifies the ADRF under unconfoundedness/consistency/positivity, and proposes pointwise undersmoothing confidence intervals rather than a simultaneous band.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v3, corresponding to Journal of Econometrics 207 (2018)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The baseline uniform deconvolution-band construction uses an auxiliary error sample; its panel route constructs such information under symmetric errors.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid multiplier-bootstrap uniform bands for nonparametric EIV regression with validation data or repeated measurements, under conventional spectral regularity.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Promote the lower open-ended question into a standalone fixed-nuisance marked-modulus theorem once the Christoffel--Darboux construction is complete, explicitly recording the observed-law TV calculation and the Bernoulli potential-outcome coupling.

Add a short theorem-level corollary comparing the new band with the pointwise known-error Huang--Zhang procedure on the common known-error submodel, including the precise implication rather than only prose contrast.

State computational complexity or a certified finite optimization formulation for evaluating the profiled sieve extrema, so the advertised sample-measurable band is operational as well as existential.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 on the fixed-nuisance marked-modulus construction and then discharge the explicit analytic-sieve stability theorem.
